eld.notes: Distinguishes ENL (English-only) from ESL (allows native-language support). 18 SH coursework + 100-hr practicum required for the subsequent endorsement.

sei.notes: No SEI mandate. District-level TBE/TPI required under 105 ILCS 5/14C and 23 IAC 228 — TBE for attendance centers with 20+ same-language ELs, TPI for fewer. 23 IAC 24.140 takes effect 2026-07-01 and drops explicit ELL language from the IPTS; flag for next refresh.

history.title: Illinois adopts State Seal of Biliteracy (PA 098-0560)
history.description: Illinois became one of the first states to authorize a State Seal of Biliteracy on high-school diplomas, certifying graduates' proficiency in English and one or more world languages. ISBE administers the program with district-level participation; the affordance is now embedded in graduation pathways and feeds into the Bilingual/ESL teacher pipeline.

history.title: 23 IAC 24.140 supersedes 24.130 as Illinois Professional Teaching Standards
history.description: ISBE's revised Illinois Professional Teaching Standards (23 IAC 24.140) take effect 2026-07-01, replacing 23 IAC 24.130. The new standards drop the explicit 'English language learners' phrasing that 24.130 carried, shifting EL-relevant competencies under broader 'diverse learners' language. Flag for re-coding `professionalStandardsMentions.el` after the transition.
